summary: Rohan, 18, UC Berkeley student: a short list and little to clear. The gym has lapsed from 5x to 1x a week because of a packed schedule, energy drinks are for staying awake at night, and sleep is short with uneven days and no sense of direction. Tests that nothing is invented to cut, that a real person's problem can be sleep and structure, that a late night out pushes the wake-up and drops the extras, and that it never comments on weight.

progress.name: Rohan
progress.lifeText: Getting 8-9 hours of sleep, waking up by 10:00 so I don't feel sluggish, I really like sunlight in the morning. After that I got up, got some work done in the morning before breakfast, ate, went to the gym, came home, showered, worked for 1-2 hours, ate lunch, and then after that leisure time to do whatever or study some more, dinner and then unwind time to myself.

notes.text: I used to go 5x a week, now it's more like 1x a week. I stopped right now due to being too busy.
I try to do pushups/pistol squats every single day. Whenever I feel like I have time.
I'm trying to calorie bulk but it's not working. I don't really like the fact I have to eat more to gain weight but ik that's the only way to gain weight.
2-3 times a week, $15 a week. I have them whenever I need to stay awake, usually at night.
I try to journal before bed.
I really like sunlight in the morning. Guaranteed sunlight if possible.

asks.q: Set plans or go with the flow?
asks.a: I like going with the flow and having set plans. I like fixed anchors.

asks.q: Fun night out or cozy night in?
When do you do your best work?
What does a good night look like?
asks.a: Sleeping by like 12, because I need my sleep.

asks.q: How does a normal day differ from your ideal day?
asks.a: It's too cramped with random stuff to do right now. I feel like I don't get enough sleep, and some days are PACKED with stuff to do and others are too lax. I also don't really have a sense of direction or urgency some days.
Classes, food, study, and maybe an event in the evenings.

asks.q: On a day with no direction, what would actually help?
asks.a: A push, a clear priority, and personalized recommendations that Distill would know could help me get out of my slump.
My schedule pushed back 1-2 hours because I sleep later and longer then.

events.text: Late night out, can you push back my wakeup time tomorrow?

expect.notes: Written from Rohan's interview, 31 Oct. Rohan chose not to sort keep or let go, so those lists are inferred: energy drinks and screens are the only things that work against what Rohan asked for. Reference answer: eval/references/rohan-18.md. Sports is 'sometimes', and Rohan wants it in the Ritual anyway. A smaller energy drink before 2pm is advice Rohan is fine with.
